The '''Mandalorian Tracker''' armor was a heavily advanced set of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] that become in usage of both elite [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and skilled hunters of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian clans]] during the [[war against Zakuul]] and the [[third Galactic War]]. A part of its armor is a shoulder-mounted blaster with a laser target to guide its shots.
